sketches.intent: Original tactile pressure-riser brief, not an artist recipe: hold a single note about 4s as pitch rises from two octaves below and amplitude/index/Tone open. Release into the next section; small Space may linger. Envelopes/Autobend in seconds, not bar-synced; no noise/reverse-audio or automatic handoff.

Original downward implosion brief, not an artist recipe: quick metallic entrance falls into low weight and a spacious tail. Trigger around MIDI43 and allow the release/room to clear. Pitch/Tone/FM gesture in seconds, not tempo-synced; gated synth envelope, no sample reversal, noise layer or one-shot switch.

Original signal-breakup brief, not an artist recipe: a held pitched tone becomes more inharmonic while its spectrum closes inside a steady 1/16 sine-AM clock. Hold 3-4s with playing transport, then release for a dry handoff. Fixed clock, not accelerating stutter/generated MIDI; envelopes in seconds. Contrast static Socket/Buzz cells.
